name: Rich People
overview: Scripture teaches that earthly riches are temporary and can corrupt, urging believers not to store up treasures on earth but rather to seek eternal treasures in heaven. The rich are warned of the spiritual dangers their wealth can bring, as Jesus declares woe to those who find their consolation in riches and reminds us that one cannot serve both God and mammon. Generosity toward the poor is highly valued, seen as lending to the Lord Himself, with the promise of divine repayment. True security comes from giving and laying up treasures that do not decay or get stolen, pointing to a life centered on God rather than material wealth.
